definition: Impossible to control, restrain, or keep from being expressed.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: Betsy broke into unexpectedly mirthful and irrepressible laughter, a thing which rarely happened with her.
example_sentence: Her irrepressible laugh carried across the whole office.
